_purpose: Automation disposition for every EC — automate (wait for automated) vs manual (cannot automated). Applies phase-3-1 automation judgment to each executable case + keys the automatable ones to a target spec. Produced by phase-3-5-automation-plan; validated by checks/automation_plan_coverage.py.
_status: EXAMPLE — dispositions the EC in 04-test-cases.json. Real output: qa/<epic>/PDT-XXXX-ucN-automation-plan.json.
_id_note: One plan entry per EC (bijection with the test-cases file). No new ids — plan entries reuse ec_id. Chain: AC → SC → EC → (this) automation disposition.
_rule: at_status 'cannot automated' <-> status 'Manual'; 'wait for automated' | 'automated' <-> status 'Automate'. Every Manual entry needs a blocker + reason. Every Automate entry needs a target whose tag == '@'+ec_id (spec-keying / bijection). blocker='live-broadcast' MUST be Manual.

plan.reason: Deterministic form interaction — input is controllable and the expected result (accept / reject text) is assertable. [phase-3-1: passes all criteria]
Role + post state are seedable via SDK; the post-status transition is assertable. [phase-3-1: passes all criteria]
ILLUSTRATIVE — a case that needs an active live broadcast: no way to start/join a real live stream deterministically on the harness (flaky / blocked). [phase-3-1 criteria 5]
